## What it is

WeGoTrip sells this as a self-guided tour in City of London, United Kingdom. It starts at Brooklands Museum, Brooklands Dr, Weybridge KT13 0SL, United Kingdom. An entry ticket is part of the package; the listing includes: Entrance ticket.

## How WeGoTrip describes it

> Step into the birthplace of British motorsport and aviation with your entry ticket to Brooklands Museum, a unique destination celebrating the golden age of speed and innovation. Located on the site of the world’s first purpose-built motor racing circuit, this museum is a must-visit for history buffs, car enthusiasts, and aviation fans alike.
>
> Explore a stunning collection of historic cars, motorcycles, and bicycles that once raced on the iconic Brooklands track. Marvel at legendary vehicles such as the Napier-Railton and immerse yourself in the thrill of motorsport history. For aviation enthusiasts, the museum offers a close-up look at vintage aircraft, including the iconic Concorde. Step aboard and experience a supersonic journey in the Concorde Simulator for an unforgettable glimpse into the future of flight.
>
> The museum also features interactive exhibits and restoration workshops where you can watch skilled engineers breathe new life into historic vehicles and planes. Wander through the atmospheric hangars and learn about the daring pilots and drivers who pushed the limits of speed and technology.
>
> Perfect for families, groups, and anyone with a passion for engineering and adventure, Brooklands Museum is a place where history comes to life. Book your ticket today and discover the incredible stories of this legendary site!
